questions.question: In Witness, Ford’s cop hides in which American religious community?
questions.note: Lancaster County, Pennsylvania. A boy named Samuel sees a murder in a Philadelphia station bathroom.

questions.question: Who directed Witness (1985)?
questions.note: The Australian director of Picnic at Hanging Rock and Dead Poets Society. He later made The Mosquito Coast with Ford.

questions.question: In Witness, what is Ford’s Philadelphia cop named?
questions.note: He is shot in the city, then hides on the Lapp farm while he heals.

questions.question: For which film was Harrison Ford nominated for a Best Actor Oscar?
questions.note: The 1986 Oscars, for 1985. He has never won a competitive acting Oscar. William Hurt won that year for Kiss of the Spider Woman.

questions.question: In Working Girl, what is Ford’s merger-advisor character named?
questions.note: Melanie Griffith is Tess McGill; Sigourney Weaver is the boss who steals her idea. Mike Nichols directed.

questions.question: In Witness, what does John Book help the Amish community build?
questions.note: The barn raising becomes the film’s best-known image of Book entering Amish life.

questions.question: Who directed Working Girl (1988)?
questions.note: Nichols also made The Graduate and Regarding Henry. The Carly Simon theme won the Oscar.

questions.question: In Frantic, Ford’s American doctor is in Paris when his wife vanishes. What got switched at the airport?
questions.note: Roman Polanski directed. 1988. The mix-up is at de Gaulle.

questions.question: In Frantic, what is Ford’s San Francisco doctor named?
questions.note: A heart surgeon. He is in town for a conference when Sondra disappears.

questions.question: Who directed Frantic?
questions.note: Polanski directed Ford as Dr. Richard Walker, whose wife vanishes in Paris.
